profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Reddit | Previously: Google
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with experience leading teams in both managerial and technical lead roles. I spent 7 years working on Google Cloud console, one of the world's largest Angular applications (10 million+ LoC, 1000+ contributors, and 100+ products).

In 2024 I stepped down from my role at Google in order to take a year to travel with my life partner before moving to Chicago, IL to begin the next chapter of our lives.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Managed a team of 6 SWEs. We were directly responsible for delivering Google Cloud console's Gemini integration on expedited timelines. Worked with technical leaders and product teams across Google Cloud to enable their AI initiatives and deliver value to our customers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Technical Lead for Google Cloud console's search experience. Worked closely with data scientists and other cross-functional partners to run data-driven experiments in order to measurably improve Google Cloud console's search experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leveraged Google infrastructure to build a first class search experience that enabled our biggest customers to navigate their cloud environments at scale.

Developed expertise in web applications, TypeScript, and Angular.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Oversaw the complete rewrite of the Google Cloud console Support UI from AngularJS to Angular while balancing incoming feature requests and business requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Engineering Resident
positions.description: Contributed to a redesign of the App Engine UI

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Used React, Redux, and Immutable JS to create testable and reusable web components
•	Developed a framework to connect our Redux store with THREE.js
•	Designed and implemented a 3 dimensional web-based interface for Doctors to design custom fitted bronchial stents

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
•	Built automation products on top of Arduino micro-controllers
•	Leveraged BACnet and modbus protocols

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Used the Django Web Framework to serve open source HTML5 games
•	Developed front-end UI using JQuery, HTML5/CSS3, and Bootstrap

honors.title: AP Scholar
honors.description: Granted to students who receive scores of 3 or higher on three or more AP Exams
